reference_sql:
SELECT pp.product_id
FROM promotion_products pp
JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
WHERE p.promo_code = 'P-2025-14'
UNION
SELECT pp.product_id
FROM promotion_products pp
JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
WHERE p.promo_code = 'P-2025-16'

other_way.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id WHERE p.promo_code IN ('P-2025-14', 'P-2025-16')
